# 1832. Check if the Sentence Is Pangram

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def checkIfPangram(self, sentence):
        """
        :type sentence: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return all(c in sentence for c in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
```
